newsitem.title: CHINA: Matsushita China freezer JV starts up.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita China freezer JV starts up.

text.p: A freezer joint venture between Japan's Matsushita Refrigeration Co and China's Wuxi Little Swan Co Ltd has begun production in eastern China, company officials said on Monday.

The Wuxi Matsushita Refrigeration Co Ltd in the city of Wuxi in the eastern province of Jiangsu, will produce 220,000 freon-free refrigerators in 1997, an official of Wuxi Matsushita said by telephone.
Wuxi Matsushita aimed to boost output to more than 500,000 units in the year 2000, the official said.
The venture, set up in July 1995, involved investment of more than $40 million, he said but gave no further details.
